page.layout: One column of index entries, with page numbers at the right of some lines. Top: running head "INDEX". Middle: section letter "O", then the entries under it. No margin notes. The foot signature is left out, as this part is not the end of the page.; One column of figures, right-aligned, running down the right side of the page, with a gap after the first group, then a line "totins" in italics and a further group of figures below it. No other text.

main_text.l: Nuptias, non esse obstaculum ad pietatem

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "prohibentes" is partly blotted by a dark mark. "honorabiles" is set with a heavy initial that is hard to make out. The page number after "praeses Deus" is cut at the margin and only a fragment shows. The numbers "39.5" and "94.10" are at the edge and may run on. The Greek-free Latin is copied as printed; long s is written as plain s. The figures are cut off on the left, so the first digit of some lines is missing or unclear; those lines are copied as far as they show. The marks [?] mark the uncertain readings.
